source_caption:
🎬 Juno (2007)

Juno follows Juno MacGuff, a witty and independent sixteen-year-old teenager whose life takes an unexpected turn when she discovers she is pregnant with her friend Paulie Bleeker’s child. After considering her options, Juno decides to place the baby for adoption and meets Mark and Vanessa Loring, a seemingly perfect couple hoping to become parents. As her pregnancy progresses, Juno navigates complicated relationships, unexpected emotional challenges, and the responsibilities of making life-changing decisions. With support from her father, stepmother, and closest friend, she gradually develops a deeper understanding of love, maturity, and family. Starring Elliot Page, Michael Cera, Jennifer Garner, and Jason Bateman, the film combines clever humor, heartfelt performances, and emotional storytelling while exploring teenage pregnancy, adoption, personal growth, responsibility, and the unpredictable journey into adulthood.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Romance

⭐ IMDb: 7.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 36m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Jason Reitman

✍️ Writer: Diablo Cody

🏆 Awards: Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay.

source_details.synopsis: Juno is a 2007 American comedy-drama film directed by Jason Reitman and written by Diablo Cody. Elliot Page stars as the title character, an independent-minded teenager confronting her unplanned pregnancy and the subsequent events that put pressures of adult life onto her. Michael Cera, Jennifer Garner, Jason Bateman, Allison Janney and J. K. Simmons also star. Filming took place in February and March of 2007 in Vancouver, British Columbia. It premiered on September 8 at the 2007 Toronto International Film Festival.
